err.setting_unknown: That is not a setting of config.lua or blocks.lua.
err.setting_locked: This setting can only change in config/config.lua.
err.setting_type: That value has the wrong type for this setting (number, text, on/off, list or table, as in config.lua).
err.setting_range: That number is outside the range this setting allows.
err.setting_text: That text has characters or a form this setting does not allow.
err.setting_vector: Enter a number for every coordinate.
err.setting_list: This setting needs a list (with as many numbers as config.lua has, where that is fixed).
err.setting_map: This setting needs a table of named entries.
err.setting_teleport_department: Each Builder teleport grant needs a department key of Config.Departments (such as sast).
err.setting_teleport_grant: Each Builder teleport grant needs either minGrade (that grade and up) or grades (only those), not both.
err.setting_key: A name in that table is not allowed.
err.setting_missing: An entry is missing a field that every entry in config.lua has.
err.setting_option: That is not one of the options of this setting.
err.setting_too_many: That list or table has too many entries.
err.setting_too_few: That list needs at least one entry.
err.setting_duplicate: That list names the same entry twice.
err.setting_too_deep: That table is nested too deep.
err.setting_min_max: The minimum cannot be above the maximum.
err.setting_default_range: The default must be between the minimum and the maximum.
err.setting_order: That would put the minimum above the maximum (see the matching setting).
err.setting_options_default: The options must keep the current default: change the default first.
err.setting_sum_100: These chances must add up to 100.
err.setting_export_folder: That folder is not there yet. Create it by hand inside the Crimson-Police folder with archived, overrides, overrides/archived and deleted inside it (the server cannot create folders on Linux), then set it again.
err.settings_not_ready: The settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.
settings.console_loaded: {n} setting(s) changed in game are in use (Admin UI → Settings)
settings.health.invalid: The setting {path} saved in game is ignored ({why}): config.lua's value is used. Change or reset it in Admin UI → Settings.
settings.health.pending: {n} setting(s) changed in game take effect after {resource} restarts
settings.health.changed: {n} setting(s) changed in game are in use (Admin UI → Settings)
settings.health.none: Every setting has its config.lua value (none changed in game)
settings.locked.database: This decides where Crimson-Police saves its data, the settings changed in game included, so it can only change in config/config.lua (then restart).
settings.locked.admin: This decides who is a Crimson-Police admin, so it can only change in config/config.lua (then restart). That way no one can hand admin to every player or lock every admin out from the tablet.
settings.subtitle: {n} settings · {changed} changed in game
settings.intro_title: You never have to edit config.lua
settings.intro: Every setting is here, with a plain description. A change is checked, saved at once and kept after restarts; Reset puts the default value back. Most changes work at once; the ones marked Needs a server restart wait for the next start of Crimson-Police.
settings.search: Search by name, Config path or description
settings.simple_more: These are the {n} everyday settings. All settings shows every one of the {total}, with its name in config.lua; the search always looks through all of them.
settings.per_mission: Change this per mission in Missions: a mission's locations switch on and off there, and an edited built-in mission keeps its own tweaks.
settings.reset_all_text: {n} setting(s) changed in game go back to their config.lua values. The change history stays.
settings.reset_all_done: Every setting is back to its config.lua value
settings.reset_done: {name} is back to its config.lua value
settings.restart_hint: Read once when Crimson-Police starts: a change is saved now and used after the next restart.
settings.reload_hint: The missions reload by themselves after this change (as Missions → Reload does). Runs already going keep what they started with.
settings.invalid_line: The saved value {value} is not allowed ({why}), so config.lua's value is used. Change or reset it.
settings.invalid_text: Their saved value is no longer allowed, so config.lua's value is used. Change or reset them (the Changed filter lists them).
settings.restart.pending: {n} change(s) take effect after Crimson-Police restarts
settings.restart.manual: Restart Crimson-Police to use them: in txAdmin restart the resource {resource}, or type restart {resource} in the server console.
settings.history.title: Change history
settings.history.subtitle: {n} change(s) made in game
settings.history.none: No setting has been changed in game yet
settings.mission.turned_on: {mission} is on: it can be drawn again
settings.mission.turned_off: {mission} is off: no new draws (runs already going finish)
settings.mission.locations_hint: Turn single locations on or off
settings.mission.changed_hint: Switched in game: Reset to default in the locations window puts config.lua's switches back
settings.mission.locations_text: A location turned off is never drawn; runs already going finish. Saved over config.lua (Config.DisabledLocations).
builder.confirm.publish_untested.title: Publish {mission} without testing?
builder.confirm.publish_untested.message: This draft has not been tested. Testing is optional: you can publish now and test it later.
builder.pub.check_untested_optional: Not tested yet (optional: you can publish without a test)
settings.locked.names: The tablet title and the two command names are fixed by the spec (another resource's command with the same name would lock you out of the Admin UI).
settings.locked.call_ids: These match the call ids of sc-npcpolice and sc-dispatch; they are not a choice.
settings.locked.code_fact: This describes what the code does; changing it here could not change the code.
settings.points_notice: {by} changed the point value {path}: {old} → {new}. It applies to runs that end after the change; runs going now may end with either value; past rows keep their points.
err.confirm_enable: Type ENABLE to turn on a money tool.
err.setting_kind_alone: A bonus's kind changes only together with its value: save both at once.
err.setting_check: This value could not be checked; nothing was saved.
err.setting_outside_map: A point is outside the map.
err.setting_arena_zone: The two Crimson-Arena no-build zones may grow, but never move, shrink or go.
err.setting_scaling_last: The last scaling row must cover the largest unit (Limits.maxUnitSize).
err.setting_xp_first: The first XP level must start at 0 XP and level 1.
err.setting_label_key: A name can only be given to an offence, a commendation kind, a badge, a bonus or a penalty.
err.setting_label_unknown: There is no such id to name.
err.setting_label_text: A name is 1 to 64 characters, without < or >.
err.setting_tweak: The mission loader refuses this tweak.
err.setting_automatic_weapon: Mission NPCs never get an automatic weapon (an SMG, a rifle or a machine gun): pick a pistol or a shotgun.
admin.action.moneySwitch: Money switch turned on or off
settings.label.Tablet.access.keybind: Players may open the tablet with a key
settings.group_help.tablet: How officers open the tablet, its commands and keys, the departments and the officer profile.
settings.group_help.missions: The mission types, stars, map blips and GPS line, the random draw, units, test runs and the Mission Builder.
settings.group_help.npcs: Where mission people appear, how hard they fight and how long they can run, and how a bigger team changes them.
settings.group_help.pay: How officers are paid for a run, who may change a payout and how long a run can be disputed.
settings.group_help.points: Points, XP levels, goals, bonuses and penalties, the leaderboard, special events, challenges and item rewards.
settings.group_help.police: Searches, arrests, custody and the decisions at the end of a case, and the rules for real players as suspects.
settings.group_help.dispatch: Mission calls officers can claim, real calls from other scripts and which alerts stay quiet during a run.
settings.group_help.server: Debug lines, the language, where data is saved, who may do what, anti-exploit checks, resets, retention and backups.
settings.label.Debug: Debug lines in the server console
settings.label.Tablet.deskDistance: Distance from the desk before the tablet closes
settings.label.Cash.dailyCap: Most cash an officer earns per day
settings.label.Payouts.requireReason: A payout change needs a reason
settings.label.Spawning.activateRange: How close officers get before mission people appear
settings.label.Spawning.minDistance: Closest a person may appear to an officer
settings.label.NpcCombat.noCriticalHits: No extra headshot damage for officers
settings.label.Markers.radioSilence: What Radio Silence hides on the map
settings.label.MissionCalls.maxOpen: Most mission calls open at once
settings.label.MissionCalls.offerTime: Seconds a mission call stays open
settings.label.Builder.spawnMargin: Room between the start and armed NPCs of a new mission
settings.label.Builder.requireTestToPubl: Supervisors must test a mission before publishing
settings.help.Debug: On: each part of Crimson-Police prints what it does in the server console. Turn it off once everything works.
settings.help.Locale: The language of the tablet and every message. It is used after the next start.
settings.help.Tablet.keybind: The key that opens the tablet for players who never picked their own. Empty = no key; players can still bind one in GTA settings.
settings.help.Tablet.deskDistance: Metres. An officer who walks further than this from the police desk sees the tablet close.
settings.help.Cash.account: Where a run's pay goes: the bank account or cash in hand.
settings.help.Cash.dailyCap: The most cash one officer can earn from runs in a day. 0 = no limit.
settings.help.Payouts.requireReason: On: anyone who changes a mission type's payout has to write why. The reason is in the audit log.
settings.help.AdminControl.editBuiltins: On: admins can open a built-in mission in the Mission Builder and change it. The change is saved as a copy; the original file stays.
settings.help.Spawning.activateRange: Metres. The people of an objective appear once an officer is this close. Bigger = they appear earlier.
settings.help.Spawning.minDistance: Metres. Nobody appears closer than this to an officer, so no one pops up in front of you.
settings.help.NpcCombat.accuracyMax: How well armed NPCs can shoot at most, from 0 to 100. Lower = they miss more.
settings.help.NpcCombat.aiDamage: How much an NPC bullet hurts. 1.0 = normal GTA damage, 0.5 = half.
settings.help.NpcCombat.noCriticalHits: On: a headshot from an NPC hurts an officer on a run like a body shot.
settings.help.Flee.sprintSeconds: A suspect who runs away sprints this many seconds before he slows to a jog.
settings.help.Flee.jogSeconds: Then he jogs this many seconds before he slows to a walk.
settings.help.Flee.walkSeconds: Then he walks this many seconds before he is worn out and gives up when an officer gets close.
settings.help.Markers.route: On: a GPS line leads to the objective. Off: only its blip shows.
settings.help.Markers.radioSilence: Once officers reach the start of a Radio Silence mission: 'area' keeps each objective's circle, 'none' keeps every blip, 'full' hides everything.
settings.help.MissionCalls.maxOpen: The most mission calls waiting on Dispatch for a unit at the same time.
settings.help.MissionCalls.offerTime: How long a mission call waits on Dispatch for a unit before it lapses.
settings.help.Builder.minLocations: How many locations a new custom mission needs before it can be published (1 = one is enough). More locations = it repeats less.
settings.help.Builder.spawnMargin: Metres outside the start circle that the armed NPCs of a new custom mission must keep.
settings.help.Builder.requireTestToPubli: On: a supervisor can publish only a draft that passed a test run. Admins never need one.
settings.help.Testing.debugOverlay: On: admins can turn on an overlay with the run's details during a test run.
settings.help.Time.resetHour: The hour (0 to 23, server time) when daily goals, the daily cash cap and Type of the Day reset. Used after the next start.
settings.help.Leaderboard.weekStartsOn: The day the weekly goals and the weekly board reset. Used after the next start.
settings.help.OfficerOptions.enabled: Turns the My options screen on or off. Off: every officer keeps the defaults.
